Ava: Heads-up: client 'NorthHarbor' wants a short POC to switch from CompetitorY -> Redwood. Scope: prompt parity, function-call names, streaming chunk behavior, and embedding billing. Can we sketch a 72h plan?
Luis: Need traffic profile. burst RPS, avg tokens, embedding volume?
Ava: AE note: spikes to ~150 RPS, typical prompts 8-30 tokens, two long sessions ~5k tokens, embeddings ~30k small texts/day.
Nina: Key risks: function-call name differences and our streaming chunk semantics. They parse custom headers today. We'll provide a compat shim.
Archie: Tokenization diffs = billing delta. Propose 1k-sample token-count check. Also propose replaying a week's worth of samples through our token model for estimator.
Sales-Eng: For embeddings, suggest batching recommendations and a POC blended rate for high-volume. Include edge-cache TTL advice.
sec-bot: Reminder: they asked for SOC2 attestation and vendor questionnaire. ETA 72h for questionnaire completion expected.
Nina: I'll prototype alias map (simple JSON) and a shim that preserves legacy headers for their parser.
Luis: I'll run a short load test: 150 RPS sustained for 15m + 2x spike for 60s and capture p95/p99 latencies.
Ava: Action items: Nina: alias shim + streaming verification (48h). Luis: load tests & capacity notes (24h). Archie: tokenizer parity samples + billing estimator (48h). Sales-Eng: draft blended embedding price for POC (48h). Security: start questionnaire (72h).
Ava: Keep this thread updated with any blockers. :+1:
